emails.subject: Quick question on software recruiter workflow
emails.body:
Hi Max,

I am building Hirelix for independent technical recruiters and small specialist firms.

Max Tech Talent's boutique focus on software, DevOps, QA automation, and front-end roles looked very relevant. Hirelix is trying to help that kind of recruiter get from a client JD to a credible shortlist faster.

It ranks real technical profiles with fit evidence, risks to verify, and outreach context a recruiter can personalize.

Would you be open to a quick look and blunt feedback on whether this would save review time on one software role?

Best,
Noah

Founder, Hirelix
